name: architect-example-web-counter
description: A Vite + TypeScript page that runs the sandbox's WASI Counter extension through @fasttrackstudio/architect's public API (docs/content/guide/extensions-in-your-web-app.md).

scripts.build: npm run extension && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test:packed: npm pack ../../features/extensions/web --pack-destination /tmp >/dev/null && npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund /tmp/fasttrackstudio-architect-0.0.0-dev.tgz && npm test
